ov: A deer of the Arctic and subarctic, called caribou in North America. It’s the only deer in which females can grow antlers, and the only deer semi-domesticated on a large scale.

why.dm: Reindeer are semi-domesticated: they are herded, but wild herds are also hunted.
why.et: Herded and hunted by northern peoples for food, clothing and transport.

rg: Circumpolar: the Arctic, subarctic, tundra and mountain regions of North America, Europe and Asia.
df: Mostly plants; in winter it digs through snow for its favourite food, reindeer lichen.

cf.tip: In most deer only the males grow antlers; in reindeer, females can grow them too.

fx: Migrating caribou normally travel about 19–55 km a day.
